notes: Redesigned incident workspace: the verdict up front (restore latency in seconds, live state vs backup), human-readable per-policy change sections instead of raw JSON, one merged timeline, a self-verifying playbook step — and restore from backup without leaving the incident.
Drift findings now know when Guard or an operator already restored a change, and scope changes show WHO was added or excluded by name — not just '1 user → 3 users'.
Live policy state highlights exactly what an incident changed: added entries in green, removed entries struck red, changed settings amber, and old → new state on every affected policy.
